title: When the lights go out, how will Europeans access their money?
gist: Power outages (20 Oct 2026 Google Cloud-linked UK outage, 2025 Iberian blackout) and a 61% YoY rise in European cyberattacks expose how digital payments and even ATMs fail together, while cash use has collapsed (3% of UK adults mainly use cash). Chatham House argues offline-capable CBDCs (digital euro, digital pound) are the fix but face double-spending, adoption and terminal-power problems, and urges EU-UK alignment via joint 72-hour outage stress tests, dual-currency NFC terminals and offline cross-border FX.

themes.theme: Offline CBDC designs: digital euro vs digital pound

insights.claim: Offline-capable central bank digital currencies (CBDCs) are a solution to payment outages because they aim to replicate the operational resilience of cash in digital form.
